name: Cyberpunk 2077
format: JSON user-setting entries with IK_* keycodes; XML mapping/context definitions
limitations: V3 specifies 28 placements but defers 30 contextual actions. Call vehicle, vehicle controls and braindance functions cannot be moved by a global text replacement.
The retained evidence distinguishes right Ctrl/Shift hold bindings from left Ctrl/Shift dash/toggle bindings. The generic planner labels do not prove they are the same physical key.
Preserve graphics hotkeys and CET/UltraPlus/ReShade settings. Existing input mods may redirect the effective XML, so their files must be audited without enabling or replacing mods.
